name: Chill Breeze Valley
summary: In western Dun Morogh, travelers cross Chill Breeze Valley between Kharanos and Gnomeregan. Refugees and young travelers follow its main trail, while dangerous beasts haunt its secluded reaches.

sections.title: A Crossroads of Snow and Claws
sections.body: Chill Breeze Valley cuts through the mountains of western Dun Morogh. The main trail runs east to west, carrying young dwarves and gnomes between Kharanos and the outskirts of Gnomeregan. A north-south branch leads into more dangerous ground. Blood stains the snow among mangled carcasses, and savage wendigos make their dens in deep ice caves. They prey on anyone who wanders into their hunting grounds.

faq.q: Where is Chill Breeze Valley located?
faq.answer: Chill Breeze Valley lies in western Dun Morogh, between Kharanos to the east and Gnomeregan to the west.

faq.q: Why is the valley so dangerous to travel through?
faq.answer: The main trail between Kharanos and Gnomeregan sees heavy foot traffic and is relatively safe. Predatory beasts hunt in the valley’s northern and southern branches, where blood stains the snow and torn carcasses mark the caves where wendigos dwell.

faq.q: What kinds of beasts make their dens here?
aliases: what lives in chill breeze valley
faq.answer: Ferocious wendigos make their dens in the valley’s deeper recesses. One especially large and powerful wendigo has claimed a cave as its lair.

angles.text: As a gnome fleeing Gnomeregan for the safety of Kharanos or Ironforge, you must make it past the predators around Chill Breeze Valley.
As a dwarf, you can test your mettle against the ferocious wendigos threatening the vital passage between central Dun Morogh and the western highlands.
